item.title: Solomon tells OpenAI CEO Sam Altman that Tumbler Ridge deserves apology
item.description: Federal artificial intelligence minister Evan Solomon says he met with the CEO of OpenAI, Sam Altman, and told him the people of Tumbler Ridge deserve an apology after the mass shooting on February 10th.

item.title: Election for Saulteau First Nations chief and council draws near
item.description: An election to select a new council and chief for Saulteau First Nations in Moberly Lake will take place on Monday March 30th.

item.title: Farmers institute to host two documentary film nights at theatre
item.description: The Peace Region Farmers Institute (PRFI) will screen two documentary films - Women Who Dig and Tea Creek - at the Lido Theatre on March 11th and April 14th.
